title.es: El del de Madrid al cielo
title.en: The One With From Madrid to Heaven

description.es: Isabel ve a Fina probándose el fular en la tienda. Fina dice que se lo regaló su padre, pero Isabel no acaba de creérselo y empieza a sospechar de la situación. Fina se lo cuenta a Marta y las dos se preocupan. Aquí es donde están las escenas en las que Fina pronuncia mal una palabra y Marta la corrige, y Marta dice "De Madrid al cielo". Marta ve a Isabel examinando la nómina de Fina y sus preocupaciones aumentan. Cuando va a contárselo a Fina, discuten, Marta besa a Fina e Isabel lo ve.
description.en: As Fina tries on the scarf at the store, Isabel sees it. Fina says her father gave it to her as a gift, but Isabel is not quite convinced and grows suspicious of the situation. Fina tells Marta about this, and the two of them worry. This is where the scenes are in which Fina mispronounces a word and Marta corrects her, and Marta says "from Madrid to heaven." Marta sees Isabel examining Fina's payslip, and her worries grow. When she goes to tell Fina about it, they argue, and Marta kisses Fina and Isabel sees it.
